{{Quote|Jettison the bodies. Choose a place where the Republic can have a good look at them.|General Grievous, after the death of Pablo-Jill|<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>}}
'''Pablo-Jill''' was an [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] native to the [[Skustell Cluster/Legends|Skustell Cluster]] who served as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Famed for bringing peace and order to the lawless [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] early in his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] career, he participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], where two hundred members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] battled the vast [[Droid/Legends|droid]] armies of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Pablo-Jill was one of few on his side to survive, though he became separated from the bulk of his fellow Jedi during the fighting.

[[19 BBY/Legends|Three years later]], he led a daring [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attempt]] to rescue [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] from the clutches of the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Many of the other Jedi gave up, but Pablo-Jill continued in his efforts to intercept Grievous's [[Tri-wing shuttle|tri-wing]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], and eventually dueled with the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] aboard the Separatist [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. Grievous proved too strong for the Ongree Jedi Knight, however, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him. After the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], Pablo-Jill's body was launched into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] for all the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces to see.

==Biography==
===Jedi Knight===
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Pablo-Jill was born in the [[Skustell Cluster/Legends|Skustell Cluster]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] some time before the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. He was a member of the [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and eventually joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], rising in ranks until he became a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. After his elevation, he was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="DB" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> tasked with bringing peace and order to the lawless world. He was successful, albeit only for a time: once he left the planet matters slowly returned to as they had been before he arrived. His efforts on Ord Mantell made him famous among the Jedi; the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] encouraged him to take an apprentice of his own, though, he never did.<ref name="DB" />

===Battle of Geonosis===
[[File:Pablo-Jill.png|thumb|right|200px|Pablo-Jill during the Battle of Geonosis.]]
He was among the Jedi stationed in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] when the Order received word that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had been captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] after tracking the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to the barren planet.<ref name="DB" /> Along with fellow Ongree Jedi [[Coleman Kcaj/Legends|Coleman Kcaj]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> and [[Jedi assault team/Legends|two hundred other members]] of the Order,<ref name="ITW:AOTC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> he flew to the Outer Rim to fight the vast droid army of the CIS. Pablo-Jill sneaked into the stands in the huge [[Petranaki arena]], where Kenobi, Republic [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and Kenobi's Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were slated for execution.<ref name="EpII">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Alongside [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] Jedi Padawan [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], Pablo-Jill fought against thousands of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in the arena; however, they were both eventually separated from the rest of the Jedi, and were left behind by the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunships led by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. They ultimately managed to survive and participated with the rest of the surviving Jedi in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], where they fought alongside battalions of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] brought by Yoda from [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Eventually, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and Jedi proved victorious, though many lives had been lost.<ref name="EpII" />

===Battle of Coruscant===
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|CIS assault]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Pablo-Jill [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Jedi interceptor]] against the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] in an attempt to recover the [[Tri-wing shuttle|shuttle]] that had abducted [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], commander of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], had kidnapped the Chancellor from the capital world, and Pablo-Jill, along with fellow Jedi [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], led the rescue attempt. They had been the closest to hitting the shuttle, but Grievous had managed to evade them by firing on local debris, which provided obstacles for the Jedi and allowed him to further outrun them. Tiin, Kolar, and Pablo-Jill were able to evade the debris, though, and were firing on the shuttle incessantly, but Grievous's superior flying ability and the ship's strong [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shields]] meant their weapons had little impact. As they exited Coruscant's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], they began to perform more complex maneuvers and were soon joined by [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]; they were slowly overpowering the shuttle's shield generator. Grievous was eventually forced to fire on innocent vessels in the vicinity in an effort to persuade the Jedi to fall back; they did so, though when it became a straight race for Grievous's flagship, the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], the Jedi, aided by several other Republic vessels, attacked the shuttle once again.<ref name="LoE" />

[[File:Pablo-Jill4.jpg|left|thumb|Pablo-Jill, Jedi Knight.]]
They were close to intercepting the vehicle when hundreds of droid fighters surged toward them, safeguarding Grievous's shuttle as it flew toward his great flagship. While many of the other pilots fell back in an attempt to defend themselves, Pablo-Jill and two others continued onwards towards the Chancellor. One of the fighters was eventually destroyed by cannon fire, but Pablo-Jill and the other pilot, a [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] male Jedi Knight named [[L'lacielo Sageon]], swerved out of the way and continued their pursuit of Grievous. The ''Invisible Hand'' used a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] to draw in Grievous's shuttle, which was heavily damaged, and with it came the interceptors of both Pablo and Sageon.<ref name="ref">These events were documented in ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', though the two Jedi were left unnamed in that novel. ''[[Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous]]'' named the two Jedi.</ref>

As soon as their ships touched down in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Pablo-Jill and the other Jedi jumped out of their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and drew their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], deflecting the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts sent at them by the CIS droids as they ran towards the shuttle, intent on rescuing Palpatine. One of them plunged a lightsaber through the hull of the ship, stirring Grievous into action. The [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] cyborg engaged the two Knights in a duel; the droids had ceased shooting as they were afraid to hit Grievous. They dueled for several moments, though in the end Grievous was too powerful for them; he stabbed downwards into each of their chests, [[Death/Legends|killing]] them. Pablo-Jill's body was launched into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] at Grievous's command for all [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic forces]] to see.<ref name="ref" /> Grievous also added Pablo-Jill's lightsaber to his collection of Jedi weapons taken from those he had slain.<ref name="Unknown Soldier" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:P-j_bg.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Pablo-Jill in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].]]
Pablo-Jill was a brave and selfless being&mdash;he risked his life for the Republic in both the Battle of Geonosis<ref name="EpII" /> and the Battle of Coruscant. Even after the ''Invisible Hand''{{'s}} tractor beam pulled<ref name="LoE" /> him and L'lacielo Sageon onto Grievous's ship,<ref name="Unknown Soldier" /> Pablo-Jill did not give up, and bravely fought the former Kaleesh [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]].<ref name="LoE" /> He also demonstrated his bravery during his time on Ord Mantell, when he almost singlehandedly brought peace to the planet of criminals and bounty hunters.<ref name="DB" /> Pablo-Jill was also extremely loyal to the Republic, the Jedi Order, and the Chancellor; he gave his life in an attempt to free the head of state, while many more senior-ranking Jedi retreated so that they could defend themselves.<ref name="LoE" />

==Powers and abilities==
Though skilled with the Force, Pablo-Jill was more martial than most Jedi, and favoured use of his lightsaber in battle.<ref name="LoE" /><ref name="EpII" /> He wielded a blue-bladed lightsaber during the Battle of Geonosis&mdash;effectively enough to survive the battle, where hundreds of other Jedi perished while fighting the vast droid army of the CIS.<ref name="EpII" /> Pablo-Jill was also quick to brandish his weapon above Coruscant in 19 BBY, and skillfully deflected the blaster bolts from Grievous's droids. Grievous described the Ongree Knight as a decent adversary, and more skilled than the ones he had encountered when taking Palpatine, among them [[Roron Corobb/Legends|Roron Corobb]], [[B'ink Utrila]], [[Foul Moudama]], and [[Roth-Del Masona]]; in the end, however, he was not strong enough to survive the encounter with Grievous and the cyborg added Pablo's lightsaber to his collection; Jill would be considered one of the General's most notorious kills. He was also a skilled pilot&mdash;having been chosen along with the likes of Saesee Tiin, one of the best Jedi pilots of the time, and Agen Kolar, for the mission to rescue Palpatine.<ref name="LoE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Pablo-Jill6.jpg|thumb|150px|A model of Pablo-Jill's head.]]
Pablo-Jill was one of few completely [[Computer/Legends|computer]]-generated characters in the [[Prequel trilogy]]. He was one of only three CGI Jedi in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. Because of Pablo-Jill's awkward, bulky form and multi-jointed legs, it was decided that he would look best using computer animation.<ref name="DB" /> He was named in a [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] update slightly over a month later. The Databank entry also gave his species and expanded upon his background.<ref name="Update">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20020621.html|text=Inside the Jedi Temple}}</ref>

There was originally some confusion between Pablo-Jill and the Ongree member of the Jedi Council seen in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], with early Set Diaries naming the other Ongree Pablo-Jill and later [[Sweitt Concorkill/Legends|Sweitt Concorkill]], though he was eventually named [[Coleman Kcaj/Legends|Coleman Kcaj]]. The character was originally meant to be Pablo-Jill, but because the Ongree in Episode III needed a more detailed CGI model, a new character was created, similar to how [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] became [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] became [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]].<ref name="Hyperspace-Mocking Heads">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/postnotes/news20040227.html|series=Episode III Post Notes|text=Mocking Heads}}</ref><ref name="Hyperspace-Jedi Council Musical Chairs">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/postnotes/news20031125.html|series=Episode III Post Notes|text=Jedi Council Musical Chairs}}</ref><ref name="Hyperspace-Episode III Set Diary - The Jedi Council Puzzle">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20040828.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=The Jedi Council Puzzle}}</ref> Eventually, ''[[Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous]]''&mdash;an article by [[Abel G. Peña]] appearing in [[Star Wars Insider 86|''Star Wars Insider'' 86]] in [[2006]]&mdash;established that one of the Jedi killed on the ''Invisible Hand'' appearing in [[James Luceno]]'s ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' was Pablo-Jill.<ref name="Unknown Soldier" /> ''Labyrinth of Evil'' named Pablo-Jill in an earlier chapter, but did not name the two Jedi killed by Grievous.<ref name="LoE" />
